abandon_criterion.note: pivot to fresh constructions only if transforms yield only d<=4 among the first 100 candidates

bar.note: mitten/ZSZ high-rate bar; Kasai [[9216,4612,<=48]] and [[16384,4142,<=40]] remain bars only

direction.expected_value: A checkable high-rate code above d=5, or a documented finding that transforms do not create distance and that fresh constructions are required.
direction.feasibility: Seeded high-rate parents (mitten, ZSZ-LP, Pauli-CPM) are available; code-calculus peel/puncture/delete generate variants on CPU; GPU RIS witnesses distances that CPU cannot reach.
direction.hypothesis: Code-calculus transforms or fresh Pauli-CPM-style constructions can produce d>=7 high-rate codes whose distances are witnessed at 300M trials, not just d=1/d=2 variants.

novelty.against: the unrestricted high-rate frontier and the Kasai bars
novelty.claim: a gate-passed high-rate code with d>=7 and a 300M-trial witness

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That code-calculus moves raise k and lower w but do not create distance at high rate, confirming the v0.1/v0.2 negative results and directing budget to new constructions.

campaign.name: High-rate high-distance witness search on GPU
campaign.notes: Requires d>=7 for submission consideration. d-only gains require a matched-depth peer audit before packaging.
